join("/a/b", "../c", "./d") = "/a/c/d"
join("a", "", "b/") = "a/b/"
resolve("/foo/bar", "./baz") = "/foo/bar/baz"
resolve("/foo/bar", "/tmp/file/") = "/tmp/file"
normalize("/foo/bar//baz/asdf/quux/..") = "/foo/bar/baz/asdf"
normalize("./a/../../b") = "../b"
relative("/data/orandea/test/aaa", "/data/orandea/impl/bbb") = "../../impl/bbb"
dirname("/a/b/c.txt") = "/a/b"
basename("/a/b/c.txt") = "c.txt"
basename("/a/b/c.txt", ".txt") = "c"
extname("index.coffee.md") = ".md"
extname(".hidden") = ""
isAbsolute("/x") = true
isAbsolute("x/y") = false

format: /home/user/dir/file.txt
